title: pentacalia ricoensis
intro: Pentacalia ricoensis, commonly known as Rico Mountain pentacalia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pentacalia ricoensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
